title: P0.88: Prebuild Resource Snapshot Nonblocking Deferral
description: Keep missing/in-flight resource snapshots from holding a watchdog prebuild_waiting dominant phase during startup.
reason: Live shortcut proof after P0.87 confirmed startup_evolution no longer blocked startup, but UI stalls still appeared with dominant_phase=prebuild_waiting:resource_snapshot_pending while snapshot_refresh_in_flight was true. Resource observation is maintenance input and must not look like an active UI wait.
next_action: Merge P0.88, update the desktop shortcut runtime, restart from shortcut, and verify runtime_audit has no prebuild_waiting:resource_snapshot_pending/resource_snapshot_refresh_in_flight stalls.
resume_hint: Snapshot-pending prebuild now emits lazy_vm_prebuild_deferred, clears watchdog dominant_phase, retries with a slower idle interval, and does not keep startup_followup_active alive.
